description: Revelation 3:2 is held with Variants on and he opened the talk from the brace of στήρισον (establish): asked 'What is the difference, and does it change the sense?', the answer gives both other readings (στήριξον, τήρησον) and that the Byzantine manuscripts split here, says what changes in the English, and does not rule which reading is right.
